name: Improvement KPI targets (quantified)

regulatory_anchors.regulation: FCA Policy Statement PS23/16: Sustainability Disclosure Requirements (SDR) and investment labels
regulatory_anchors.article: Chapter 4: Sustainability labels (paragraphs 4.28-4.31 — Sustainability Improvers requires quantified targets to measure improvement against)

summary: Tests whether the developer has set quantified targets for the improvement trajectory — what 'improved' looks like, numerically. PS23/16 requires the plan to be 'measurable'; PB methodology v3.5 calibrates this as ≥3 of the four data-centre KPIs (PUE target, renewable energy %, GHG reduction %, WUE target) being quantified for the aligned band, with target values that materially improve on the baseline established in c5.
